key_concepts: Weather elements include humidity, atmospheric pressure, air temperature, rainfall, and cl
Weather instruments are used to measure specific weather elements
A wind vane shows wind direction
Air pressure is the push of air molecules on an area
Rising barometer readings indicate sunny and dry weather
Falling barometer readings indicate stormy and wet weather
Weather symbols represent weather elements and conditions
Weather observations should be recorded daily at set times
Weather data collected over time can show patterns
Weather reports and predictions can be based on recorded observations
